senses.gloss: f. (אָנַן) grief, retired mourning, esp. the status of the mourner between death and burial of a kinsman, contrad. to אֲבֵילָה, אֲבֵילוּת. Lam. R. introd. (R. Abbahu 4) א׳ מבפנים ăninah is indoor (retired) grief.
units: Y. Hor. III, 48ᵃ top איזהו א׳ וכ׳ what is ăninah?—The time from death to &c.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Pesachim 7:9:3">Y. Pes. VII, 35ᵃ</cite> top <he>אֲנִינַת לילה תורה</he> observance of ăninah by night is biblical.
Gen. R. s. 85 he is named Onan שהביא א׳ לעצמו because he brought mourning over his early death.
